title: Pattern of 100% CPU since recent updates.
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior Been running this in LXC for some time back to sept 2025. A pattern has emerged where it's killing 100% CPU. It can be correlated to some migrator process that keeps firing ```2026-07-02 04:00:52.3|Info|FluentMigrator.Runner.MigrationRunner|DatabaseEngineVersionCheck migrated 2026-07-02 04:00:52.3|Info|FluentMigrator.Runner.MigrationRunner|=> 0.0021451s ``` ### Expected Behavior CPU should not spike to 100% and migrator process continue firing. ### Steps To Reproduce I believe this is an issue with the latest versions that have been pushed so may be able to easily reproduce or gather logs from others. ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Debian 13 - Sonarr: 4.0.18.2971 - Docker Install: No - Using Reverse Proxy: Yes - Browser: Chrome - Database: SQLite 3.46.1 ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs? [sonarr.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29612259/sonarr.txt) ### Anything else? _No response_
author: ChrisColotti

comments.author: augustuen
comments.body: Those aren't `trace` logs, which are required for bug reports. The migration runner seems to run every time Sonarr restarts, which is expected.
